   479	} satisfies Record<Locale, any>;
   480	
   481	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   482	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   483	
   484	  const saved =
   485	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   486	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   487	
   488	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   489	
   490	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   491	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   492	
   493	  return "es";
   494	}

   720	export default function AlimentacionBebidasSectorPage() {
   721	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   722	
   723	  useEffect(() => {
   724	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   725	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   726	
   727	      const next =
   728	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   729	          ? rawDetail
   730	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   731	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   732	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   733	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   734	              : null;
   735	
   736	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   737	        setLocale(next);
   738	        return;
   739	      }
   740	
   741	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   742	    };
   743	
   744	    updateLocale();
   745	
   746	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   747	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   748	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   749	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   750	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   751	
   752	    return () => {
   753	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   754	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   755	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   756	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);

   502	} satisfies Record<Locale, any>;
   503	
   504	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   505	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   506	
   507	  const saved =
   508	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   509	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   510	
   511	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   512	
   513	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   514	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   515	
   516	  return "es";
   517	}

   743	export default function AutomocionSectorPage() {
   744	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   745	
   746	  useEffect(() => {
   747	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   748	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   749	
   750	      const next =
   751	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   752	          ? rawDetail
   753	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   754	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   755	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   756	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   757	              : null;
   758	
   759	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   760	        setLocale(next);
   761	        return;
   762	      }
   763	
   764	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   765	    };
   766	
   767	    updateLocale();
   768	
   769	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   770	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   771	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   772	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   773	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   774	
   775	    return () => {
   776	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   777	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   778	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   779	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   780	      window.removeEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);

   591	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   592	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   593	
   594	  const saved =
   595	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   596	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   597	
   598	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   599	
   600	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   601	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   602	
   603	  return "es";
   604	}

   830	export default function ConsumoDistribucionSectorPage() {
   831	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   832	
   833	  useEffect(() => {
   834	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   835	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   836	
   837	      const next =
   838	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   839	          ? rawDetail
   840	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   841	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   842	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   843	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   844	              : null;
   845	
   846	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   847	        setLocale(next);
   848	        return;
   849	      }
   850	
   851	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   852	    };
   853	
   854	    updateLocale();
   855	
   856	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   857	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   858	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   859	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   860	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   861	
   862	    return () => {
   863	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   864	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   865	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   866	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);

   310	
   311	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   312	  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
   313	    return "es";
   314	  }
   315	
   316	  const saved =
   317	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   318	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   319	
   320	  if (saved === "es" || saved === "en" || saved === "zh") {
   321	    return saved;
   322	  }
   323	
   324	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   325	
   326	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh") {
   327	    return htmlLang;
   328	  }
   329	
   330	  return "es";
   331	}

   333	function Icon({ name }: { name: IconName }) {
   334	  const common = {
   335	    width: 38,
   336	    height: 38,
   337	    viewBox: "0 0 24 24",

   344	  };
   345	
   346	  switch (name) {
   347	    case "timer":

   456	export default function EnergiasRenovablesSectorPage() {
   457	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   458	
   459	  useEffect(() => {
   460	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   461	      const rawDetail =
   462	        event instanceof CustomEvent
   463	          ? event.detail
   464	          : null;
   465	
   466	      const next =
   467	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   468	          ? rawDetail
   469	          : rawDetail &&
   470	              typeof rawDetail === "object" &&
   471	              "locale" in rawDetail
   472	            ? String(
   473	                (rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale,
   474	              )
   475	            : rawDetail &&
   476	                typeof rawDetail === "object" &&
   477	                "language" in rawDetail
   478	              ? String(
   479	                  (rawDetail as { language?: unknown })
   480	                    .language,
   481	                )
   482	              : null;
   483	
   484	      if (
   485	        next === "es" ||
   486	        next === "en" ||
   487	        next === "zh"
   488	      ) {
   489	        setLocale(next);
   490	        return;
   491	      }
   492	
   493	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   494	    };
   495	
   496	    updateLocale();
   497	
   498	    window.addEventListener(
   499	      "storage",
   500	      updateLocale,
   501	    );
   502	
   503	    window.addEventListener(
   504	      "languagechange",
   505	      updateLocale,
   506	    );
   507	
   508	    window.addEventListener(
   509	      "localechange",
   510	      updateLocale,
   511	    );
   512	
   513	    window.addEventListener(
   514	      "across-language-change",
   515	      updateLocale,
   516	    );
   517	
   518	    window.addEventListener(
   519	      "across-locale-change",
   520	      updateLocale,
   521	    );
   522	
   523	    return () => {
   524	      window.removeEventListener(
   525	        "storage",
   526	        updateLocale,
   527	      );
   528	
   529	      window.removeEventListener(
   530	        "languagechange",
   531	        updateLocale,
   532	      );
   533	
   534	      window.removeEventListener(
   535	        "localechange",
   536	        updateLocale,
   537	      );
   538	
   539	      window.removeEventListener(
   540	        "across-language-change",
   541	        updateLocale,
   542	      );
   543	
   544	      window.removeEventListener(
   545	        "across-locale-change",

   548	    };

   307	
   308	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   309	  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
   310	    return "es";
   311	  }
   312	
   313	  const saved =
   314	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   315	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   316	
   317	  if (saved === "es" || saved === "en" || saved === "zh") {
   318	    return saved;
   319	  }
   320	
   321	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   322	
   323	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh") {
   324	    return htmlLang;
   325	  }
   326	
   327	  return "es";
   328	}

   330	function Icon({ name }: { name: IconName }) {
   331	  const common = {
   332	    width: 38,
   333	    height: 38,
   334	    viewBox: "0 0 24 24",
   335	    fill: "none",
   336	    stroke: "currentColor",
   337	    strokeWidth: 1.7,
   338	    strokeLinecap: "round" as const,
   339	    strokeLinejoin: "round" as const,
   340	    "aria-hidden": true,
   341	  };
   342	
   343	  switch (name) {
   344	    case "timer":
   345	      return (
   346	        <svg {...common}>
   347	          <path d="M12 8v5l3 2" />
   348	          <path d="M9 2h6" />
   349	          <path d="M12 4a8 8 0 1 0 0 16 8 8 0 0 0 0-16Z" />
   350	        </svg>
   351	      );
   352	
   353	    case "plane":
   354	      return (
   355	        <svg {...common}>
   356	          <path d="M10.5 13.5 3 21l2.8-8.2L3 10l9 1 5.7-5.7a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 3 3L15 14l1 9-2.8-2.8L5 23l7.5-7.5" />
   357	        </svg>
   358	      );
   359	
   360	    case "globe":
   361	      return (
   362	        <svg {...common}>
   363	          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" />
   364	          <path d="M3 12h18" />
   365	          <path d="M12 3c2.3 2.5 3.5 5.5 3.5 9S14.3 18.5 12 21" />
   366	          <path d="M12 3c-2.3 2.5-3.5 5.5-3.5 9s1.2 6.5 3.5 9" />
   367	        </svg>
   368	      );
   369	
   370	    case "box":
   371	      return (
   372	        <svg {...common}>
   373	          <path d="m21 8-9-5-9 5 9 5 9-5Z" />
   374	          <path d="M3 8v8l9 5 9-5V8" />
   375	          <path d="M12 13v8" />
   376	        </svg>
   377	      );
   378	
   379	    case "route":
   380	      return (
   381	        <svg {...common}>
   382	          <path d="M4 6h8a4 4 0 0 1 0 8H9a4 4 0 0 0 0 8h11" />
   383	          <path d="M4 6l3-3" />
   384	          <path d="M4 6l3 3" />
   385	        </svg>
   386	      );
   387	
   388	    case "document":
   389	      return (
   390	        <svg {...common}>
   391	          <path d="M14 3H7a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h10a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8l-5-5Z" />

   393	          <path d="M8 13h8" />

   399	      return (

   402	          <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="2.3" />
   403	        </svg>
   404	      );
   405

   453	export default function EnergiasRenovablesSectorPage() {
   454	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   455	
   456	  useEffect(() => {
   457	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   458	      const rawDetail =
   459	        event instanceof CustomEvent
   460	          ? event.detail
   461	          : null;
   462	
   463	      const next =
   464	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   465	          ? rawDetail
   466	          : rawDetail &&
   467	              typeof rawDetail === "object" &&
   468	              "locale" in rawDetail
   469	            ? String(
   470	                (rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale,
   471	              )
   472	            : rawDetail &&
   473	                typeof rawDetail === "object" &&
   474	                "language" in rawDetail
   475	              ? String(
   476	                  (rawDetail as { language?: unknown })
   477	                    .language,
   478	                )
   479	              : null;
   480	
   481	      if (
   482	        next === "es" ||
   483	        next === "en" ||
   484	        next === "zh"
   485	      ) {
   486	        setLocale(next);
   487	        return;
   488	      }
   489	
   490	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   491	    };
   492	
   493	    updateLocale();
   494	
   495	    window.addEventListener(
   496	      "storage",
   497	      updateLocale,
   498	    );
   499	
   500	    window.addEventListener(
   501	      "languagechange",
   502	      updateLocale,
   503	    );
   504	
   505	    window.addEventListener(
   506	      "localechange",
   507	      updateLocale,
   508	    );
   509	
   510	    window.addEventListener(
   511	      "across-language-change",
   512	      updateLocale,
   513	    );
   514	
   515	    window.addEventListener(
   516	      "across-locale-change",
   517	      updateLocale,
   518	    );
   519	
   520	    return () => {
   521	      window.removeEventListener(
   522	        "storage",
   523	        updateLocale,
   524	      );
   525	
   526	      window.removeEventListener(
   527	        "languagechange",
   528	        updateLocale,
   529	      );
   530	
   531	      window.removeEventListener(
   532	        "localechange",
   533	        updateLocale,
   534	      );
   535	
   536	      window.removeEventListener(
   537	        "across-language-change",
   538	        updateLocale,
   539	      );
   540	
   541	      window.removeEventListener(
   542	        "across-locale-change",
   543	        updateLocale,
   544	      );
   545	    };
   546	  }, []);
   547	
   548	  const t = copy[locale];
   549

   551	    "box",
   552	    "route",
   553	    "document",
   554	    "tracking",
   555	  ];

   558	    "search",
   559	    "document",
   560	    "route",
   561	    "truck",
   562	  ];
   563	
   564	  return (
   565	    <div className="page-shell">
   566	      <Header />
   567

   569

   571	            HERO

   577	          data-service-hero-home="true"
   578	        >
   579	          <Image

   581	            alt={t.heroTitle}
   582	            fill
   583	            priority
   584	            sizes="(max-width: 900px) 0px, 100vw"
   585	            className={`${styles.heroImage} ${styles.heroImageDesktop}`}
   586	          />
   587

   595	          />
   596	
   597	          <div className={styles.heroOverlay} />
   598	
   599	          <div className={styles.heroInner}>
   600	            <div className={styles.heroContent}>

   306	} satisfies Record<Locale, any>;
   307	
   308	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   309	  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
   310	    return "es";
   311	  }
   312	
   313	  const saved =
   314	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   315	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   316	
   317	  if (saved === "es" || saved === "en" || saved === "zh") {
   318	    return saved;
   319	  }
   320	
   321	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   322	
   323	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh") {
   324	    return htmlLang;
   325	  }
   326	
   327	  return "es";
   328	}

   330	function Icon({ name }: { name: IconName }) {
   331	  const common = {
   332	    width: 38,
   333	    height: 38,
   334	    viewBox: "0 0 24 24",
   335	    fill: "none",
   336	    stroke: "currentColor",
   337	    strokeWidth: 1.7,
   338	    strokeLinecap: "round" as const,
   339	    strokeLinejoin: "round" as const,
   340	    "aria-hidden": true,
   341	  };
   342	
   343	  switch (name) {
   344	    case "timer":
   345	      return (
   346	        <svg {...common}>
   347	          <path d="M12 8v5l3 2" />
   348	          <path d="M9 2h6" />
   349	          <path d="M12 4a8 8 0 1 0 0 16 8 8 0 0 0 0-16Z" />
   350	        </svg>
   351	      );
   352	
   353	    case "plane":
   354	      return (
   355	        <svg {...common}>
   356	          <path d="M10.5 13.5 3 21l2.8-8.2L3 10l9 1 5.7-5.7a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 3 3L15 14l1 9-2.8-2.8L5 23l7.5-7.5" />
   357	        </svg>
   358	      );
   359	
   360	    case "globe":
   361	      return (
   362	        <svg {...common}>
   363	          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" />
   364	          <path d="M3 12h18" />
   365	          <path d="M12 3c2.3 2.5 3.5 5.5 3.5 9S14.3 18.5 12 21" />
   366	          <path d="M12 3c-2.3 2.5-3.5 5.5-3.5 9s1.2 6.5 3.5 9" />
   367	        </svg>
   368	      );
   369	
   370	    case "box":
   371	      return (
   372	        <svg {...common}>
   373	          <path d="m21 8-9-5-9 5 9 5 9-5Z" />
   374	          <path d="M3 8v8l9 5 9-5V8" />
   375	          <path d="M12 13v8" />
   376	        </svg>
   377	      );
   378	
   379	    case "route":

   381	        <svg {...common}>

   384	          <path d="M4 6l3 3" />
   385	        </svg>
   386	      );
   387	
   388	    case "document":
   389	      return (
   390	        <svg {...common}>
   391	          <path d="M14 3H7a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h10a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8l-5-5Z" />
   392	          <path d="M14 3v5h5" />
   393	          <path d="M8 13h8" />
   394	          <path d="M8 17h6" />
   395	        </svg>
   396	      );

   399	      return (

   401	          <path d="M12 21s7-5.2 7-11a7 7 0 0 0-14 0c0 5.8 7 11 7 11Z" />
   402	          <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="2.3" />
   403	        </svg>
   404	      );
   405	
   406	    case "search":
   407	      return (
   408	        <svg {...common}>
   409	          <circle cx="10.5" cy="10.5" r="6.5" />

   412	      );
   413

   453	export default function EnergiasRenovablesSectorPage() {
   454	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   455	
   456	  useEffect(() => {
   457	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   458	      const rawDetail =
   459	        event instanceof CustomEvent
   460	          ? event.detail
   461	          : null;
   462	
   463	      const next =
   464	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   465	          ? rawDetail
   466	          : rawDetail &&
   467	              typeof rawDetail === "object" &&
   468	              "locale" in rawDetail
   469	            ? String(
   470	                (rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale,
   471	              )
   472	            : rawDetail &&
   473	                typeof rawDetail === "object" &&
   474	                "language" in rawDetail
   475	              ? String(
   476	                  (rawDetail as { language?: unknown })
   477	                    .language,
   478	                )
   479	              : null;
   480	
   481	      if (
   482	        next === "es" ||
   483	        next === "en" ||
   484	        next === "zh"
   485	      ) {
   486	        setLocale(next);
   487	        return;
   488	      }
   489	
   490	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   491	    };
   492	
   493	    updateLocale();
   494	
   495	    window.addEventListener(
   496	      "storage",
   497	      updateLocale,
   498	    );
   499	
   500	    window.addEventListener(
   501	      "languagechange",
   502	      updateLocale,
   503	    );
   504	
   505	    window.addEventListener(
   506	      "localechange",
   507	      updateLocale,
   508	    );
   509	
   510	    window.addEventListener(
   511	      "across-language-change",
   512	      updateLocale,
   513	    );
   514	
   515	    window.addEventListener(
   516	      "across-locale-change",
   517	      updateLocale,
   518	    );
   519	
   520	    return () => {
   521	      window.removeEventListener(
   522	        "storage",
   523	        updateLocale,
   524	      );
   525	
   526	      window.removeEventListener(
   527	        "languagechange",
   528	        updateLocale,
   529	      );
   530	
   531	      window.removeEventListener(
   532	        "localechange",
   533	        updateLocale,
   534	      );
   535	
   536	      window.removeEventListener(
   537	        "across-language-change",
   538	        updateLocale,
   539	      );
   540	
   541	      window.removeEventListener(
   542	        "across-locale-change",
   543	        updateLocale,
   544	      );
   545	    };
   546	  }, []);
   547	
   548	  const t = copy[locale];
   549	
   550	  const trustIcons: IconName[] = [
   551	    "box",
   552	    "route",
   553	    "document",
   554	    "tracking",
   555	  ];
   556	
   557	  const pillarIcons: IconName[] = [
   558	    "search",
   559	    "document",
   560	    "route",
   561	    "truck",
   562	  ];
   563	
   564	  return (
   565	    <div className="page-shell">
   566	      <Header />
   567	
   568	      <main className={styles.page}>
   569	
   570	        {/* =========================
   571	            HERO
   572	        ========================== */}
   573	
   574	        <section
   575	          className={styles.hero}
   576	          data-aereo-hero="true"
   577	          data-service-hero-home="true"
   578	        >
   579	          <Image
   580	            src="/images/sectores/energiasrenovables.png"
   581	            alt={t.heroTitle}
   582	            fill
   583	            priority
   584	            sizes="(max-width: 900px) 0px, 100vw"
   585	            className={`${styles.heroImage} ${styles.heroImageDesktop}`}
   586	          />
   587	
   588	          <Image
   589	            src="/images/sectores/energiasrenovables.png"
   590	            alt={t.heroTitle}
   591	            fill

   598

   307	
   308	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   309	  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
   310	    return "es";
   311	  }
   312	
   313	  const saved =
   314	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   315	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   316	
   317	  if (saved === "es" || saved === "en" || saved === "zh") {
   318	    return saved;
   319	  }
   320	
   321	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   322	
   323	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh") {
   324	    return htmlLang;
   325	  }
   326	
   327	  return "es";
   328	}

   330	function Icon({ name }: { name: IconName }) {
   331	  const common = {
   332	    width: 38,
   333	    height: 38,
   334	    viewBox: "0 0 24 24",
   335	    fill: "none",
   336	    stroke: "currentColor",
   337	    strokeWidth: 1.7,
   338	    strokeLinecap: "round" as const,
   339	    strokeLinejoin: "round" as const,
   340	    "aria-hidden": true,
   341	  };
   342	
   343	  switch (name) {
   344	    case "timer":
   345	      return (
   346	        <svg {...common}>
   347	          <path d="M12 8v5l3 2" />
   348	          <path d="M9 2h6" />
   349	          <path d="M12 4a8 8 0 1 0 0 16 8 8 0 0 0 0-16Z" />
   350	        </svg>
   351	      );
   352	
   353	    case "plane":
   354	      return (
   355	        <svg {...common}>
   356	          <path d="M10.5 13.5 3 21l2.8-8.2L3 10l9 1 5.7-5.7a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 3 3L15 14l1 9-2.8-2.8L5 23l7.5-7.5" />
   357	        </svg>
   358	      );
   359	
   360	    case "globe":
   361	      return (
   362	        <svg {...common}>
   363	          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" />
   364	          <path d="M3 12h18" />
   365	          <path d="M12 3c2.3 2.5 3.5 5.5 3.5 9S14.3 18.5 12 21" />
   366	          <path d="M12 3c-2.3 2.5-3.5 5.5-3.5 9s1.2 6.5 3.5 9" />
   367	        </svg>
   368	      );
   369	
   370	    case "box":
   371	      return (
   372	        <svg {...common}>
   373	          <path d="m21 8-9-5-9 5 9 5 9-5Z" />
   374	          <path d="M3 8v8l9 5 9-5V8" />
   375	          <path d="M12 13v8" />
   376	        </svg>
   377	      );
   378	
   379	    case "route":
   380	      return (
   381	        <svg {...common}>
   382	          <path d="M4 6h8a4 4 0 0 1 0 8H9a4 4 0 0 0 0 8h11" />
   383	          <path d="M4 6l3-3" />
   384	          <path d="M4 6l3 3" />
   385	        </svg>
   386	      );
   387	
   388	    case "document":
   389	      return (
   390	        <svg {...common}>
   391	          <path d="M14 3H7a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h10a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8l-5-5Z" />
   392	          <path d="M14 3v5h5" />
   393	          <path d="M8 13h8" />
   394	          <path d="M8 17h6" />
   395	        </svg>
   396	      );
   397	
   398	    case "tracking":
   399	      return (
   400	        <svg {...common}>
   401	          <path d="M12 21s7-5.2 7-11a7 7 0 0 0-14 0c0 5.8 7 11 7 11Z" />
   402	          <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="2.3" />
   403	        </svg>
   404	      );
   405	
   406	    case "search":
   407	      return (
   408	        <svg {...common}>
   409	          <circle cx="10.5" cy="10.5" r="6.5" />
   410	          <path d="m16 16 5 5" />
   411	        </svg>
   412	      );
   413	
   414	    case "truck":
   415	      return (
   416	        <svg {...common}>
   417	          <path d="M3 7h11v9H3z" />
   418	          <path d="M14 10h4l3 3v3h-7z" />
   419	          <circle cx="7" cy="18" r="2" />
   420	          <circle cx="18" cy="18" r="2" />
   421	        </svg>

   453	export default function EnergiasRenovablesSectorPage() {
   454	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   455	
   456	  useEffect(() => {
   457	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   458	      const rawDetail =
   459	        event instanceof CustomEvent
   460	          ? event.detail
   461	          : null;
   462	
   463	      const next =
   464	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   465	          ? rawDetail
   466	          : rawDetail &&
   467	              typeof rawDetail === "object" &&
   468	              "locale" in rawDetail
   469	            ? String(
   470	                (rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale,
   471	              )
   472	            : rawDetail &&
   473	                typeof rawDetail === "object" &&
   474	                "language" in rawDetail
   475	              ? String(
   476	                  (rawDetail as { language?: unknown })
   477	                    .language,
   478	                )
   479	              : null;
   480	
   481	      if (
   482	        next === "es" ||
   483	        next === "en" ||
   484	        next === "zh"
   485	      ) {
   486	        setLocale(next);
   487	        return;
   488	      }
   489	
   490	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   491	    };
   492	
   493	    updateLocale();
   494	
   495	    window.addEventListener(
   496	      "storage",
   497	      updateLocale,
   498	    );
   499	
   500	    window.addEventListener(
   501	      "languagechange",
   502	      updateLocale,
   503	    );
   504	
   505	    window.addEventListener(
   506	      "localechange",
   507	      updateLocale,
   508	    );
   509	
   510	    window.addEventListener(
   511	      "across-language-change",
   512	      updateLocale,
   513	    );
   514	
   515	    window.addEventListener(
   516	      "across-locale-change",
   517	      updateLocale,
   518	    );
   519	
   520	    return () => {
   521	      window.removeEventListener(
   522	        "storage",
   523	        updateLocale,
   524	      );
   525	
   526	      window.removeEventListener(
   527	        "languagechange",
   528	        updateLocale,
   529	      );
   530	
   531	      window.removeEventListener(
   532	        "localechange",
   533	        updateLocale,
   534	      );
   535	
   536	      window.removeEventListener(
   537	        "across-language-change",
   538	        updateLocale,
   539	      );
   540	
   541	      window.removeEventListener(
   542	        "across-locale-change",
   543	        updateLocale,
   544	      );
   545	    };
   546	  }, []);
   547	
   548	  const t = copy[locale];
   549

   551	    "box",
   552	    "route",
   553	    "document",

   558	    "search",
   559	    "document",
   560	    "route",
   561	    "truck",
   562	  ];
   563	
   564	  return (
   565	    <div className="page-shell">
   566	      <Header />
   567	
   568	      <main className={styles.page}>
   569	
   570	        {/* =========================
   571	            HERO
   572	        ========================== */}
   573	
   574	        <section
   575	          className={styles.hero}
   576	          data-aereo-hero="true"
   577	          data-service-hero-home="true"
   578	        >
   579	          <Image
   580	            src="/images/sectores/energiasrenovables.png"
   581	            alt={t.heroTitle}
   582	            fill
   583	            priority
   584	            sizes="(max-width: 900px) 0px, 100vw"
   585	            className={`${styles.heroImage} ${styles.heroImageDesktop}`}
   586	          />
   587	
   588	          <Image

   590	            alt={t.heroTitle}
   591	            fill

   502	} satisfies Record<Locale, any>;
   503	
   504	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   505	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   506	
   507	  const saved =
   508	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   509	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   510	
   511	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   512	
   513	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   514	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   515	
   516	  return "es";
   517	}

   519	type IconName =
   520	  | "timer"
   521	  | "shield"
   522	  | "document"
   523	  | "tracking"
   524	  | "airport"
   525	  | "box"
   526	  | "plane"
   527	  | "diamond"
   528	  | "charter"
   529	  | "globe"
   530	  | "door"
   531	  | "gear"
   532	  | "laptop"
   533	  | "medical"
   534	  | "cart"
   535	  | "search"
   536	  | "route"
   537	  | "package"
   538	  | "truck"
   539	  | "headset";
   540	
   541	function Icon({ name }: { name: IconName }) {
   542	  const common = {
   543	    width: 38,
   544	    height: 38,
   545	    viewBox: "0 0 24 24",
   546	    fill: "none",
   547	    stroke: "currentColor",
   548	    strokeWidth: 1.7,
   549	    strokeLinecap: "round" as const,
   550	    strokeLinejoin: "round" as const,
   551	    "aria-hidden": true,
   552	  };
   553	
   554	  switch (name) {
   555	    case "timer":
   556	      return (
   557	        <svg {...common}>
   558	          <path d="M12 8v5l3 2" />
   559	          <path d="M9 2h6" />
   560	          <path d="M12 4a8 8 0 1 0 0 16 8 8 0 0 0 0-16Z" />
   561	        </svg>
   562	      );
   563	
   564	    case "shield":
   565	      return (
   566	        <svg {...common}>
   567	          <path d="M12 3 5 6v5c0 4.4 2.8 8.3 7 10 4.2-1.7 7-5.6 7-10V6l-7-3Z" />
   568	          <path d="m9.5 12 1.8 1.8 3.7-4" />
   569	        </svg>
   570	      );
   571	
   572	    case "document":

   747	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   748	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   749	
   750	      const next =
   751	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   752	          ? rawDetail
   753	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   754	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   755	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   756	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   757	              : null;
   758	
   759	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   760	        setLocale(next);
   761	        return;
   762	      }
   763	
   764	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   765	    };
   766	
   767	    updateLocale();
   768	
   769	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   770	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   771	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   772	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   773	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   774	
   775	    return () => {
   776	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   777	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   778	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   779	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);

  1094	                </article>
  1095	              ))}
  1096	            </div>
  1097	
  1098	          </div>
  1099	        </section>
  1100	
  1101	        <Certifications />
  1102	
  1103	        <SectorLeadForm />
  1104	
  1105	</main>
  1106	
  1107	      <Footer />
  1108	    </div>
  1109	  );
  1110	}

   502	} satisfies Record<Locale, any>;
   503	
   504	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   505	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   506	
   507	  const saved =
   508	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   509	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   510	
   511	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   512	
   513	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   514	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   515	
   516	  return "es";
   517	}

   743	export default function QuimicoSectorPage() {
   744	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   745	
   746	  useEffect(() => {
   747	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   748	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   749	
   750	      const next =
   751	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   752	          ? rawDetail
   753	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   754	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   755	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   756	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   757	              : null;
   758	
   759	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   760	        setLocale(next);
   761	        return;
   762	      }
   763	
   764	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   765	    };
   766	
   767	    updateLocale();
   768	
   769	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   770	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   771	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   772	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   773	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   774	
   775	    return () => {
   776	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   777	      window.removeEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   778	      window.removeEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   779	      window.removeEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   780	      window.removeEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   781	    };

   502	} satisfies Record<Locale, any>;
   503	
   504	function getInitialLocale(): Locale {
   505	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "es";
   506	
   507	  const saved =
   508	    window.localStorage.getItem("locale") ||
   509	    window.localStorage.getItem("across-locale");
   510	
   511	  if (saved === "en" || saved === "zh" || saved === "es") return saved;
   512	
   513	  const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang;
   514	  if (htmlLang === "en" || htmlLang === "zh" || htmlLang === "es") return htmlLang;
   515	
   516	  return "es";
   517	}

   747	    const updateLocale = (event?: Event) => {
   748	      const rawDetail = event instanceof CustomEvent ? event.detail : null;
   749	
   750	      const next =
   751	        typeof rawDetail === "string"
   752	          ? rawDetail
   753	          : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "locale" in rawDetail
   754	            ? String((rawDetail as { locale?: unknown }).locale)
   755	            : rawDetail && typeof rawDetail === "object" && "language" in rawDetail
   756	              ? String((rawDetail as { language?: unknown }).language)
   757	              : null;
   758	
   759	      if (next === "es" || next === "en" || next === "zh") {
   760	        setLocale(next);
   761	        return;
   762	      }
   763	
   764	      setLocale(getInitialLocale());
   765	    };
   766	
   767	    updateLocale();
   768	
   769	    window.addEventListener("storage", updateLocale);
   770	    window.addEventListener("languagechange", updateLocale);
   771	    window.addEventListener("localechange", updateLocale);
   772	    window.addEventListener("across-language-change", updateLocale);
   773	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", updateLocale);
   774	
   775	    return () => {
   776	      window.removeEventListener("storage", updateLocale);

   170	export default function Hero() {
   171	  const desktopVideoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement | null>(null);
   172	  const mobileVideoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement | null>(null);
   173	
   174	  useEffect(() => {
   175	    // ACROSS_AUTOPLAY_FORCE_FINAL
   176	    const videos = [desktopVideoRef.current, mobileVideoRef.current].filter(Boolean) as HTMLVideoElement[];
   177	
   178	    const prepareVideo = (video: HTMLVideoElement) => {
   179	      video.muted = true;
   180	      video.defaultMuted = true;
   181	      video.autoplay = true;
   182	      video.loop = true;
   183	      video.playsInline = true;
   184	      video.preload = "auto";
   185	      video.playbackRate = 0.72;
   186	
   187	      video.setAttribute("muted", "");
   188	      video.setAttribute("autoplay", "");
   189	      video.setAttribute("playsinline", "");
   190	      video.setAttribute("webkit-playsinline", "");
   191	      video.setAttribute("loop", "");
   192	      video.setAttribute("preload", "auto");
   193	    };
   194	
   195	    const forcePlay = () => {
   196	      videos.forEach((video) => {
   197	        prepareVideo(video);
   198	
   199	        if (video.paused || video.readyState >= 2) {
   200	          const promise = video.play();
   201	          if (promise && typeof promise.catch === "function") {
   202	            promise.catch(() => {
   203	              // El navegador puede bloquear hasta el primer gesto.
   204	            });
   205	          }
   206	        }
   207	      });
   208	    };
   209	
   210	    videos.forEach((video) => {
   211	      prepareVideo(video);
   212	
   213	      video.addEventListener("loadedmetadata", forcePlay);
   214	      video.addEventListener("loadeddata", forcePlay);
   215	      video.addEventListener("canplay", forcePlay);
   216	      video.addEventListener("canplaythrough", forcePlay);
   217	      video.addEventListener("pause", forcePlay);
   218	    });
   219	
   220	    forcePlay();
   221	
   222	    const timers = [
   223	      window.setTimeout(forcePlay, 80),
   224	      window.setTimeout(forcePlay, 250),
   225	      window.setTimeout(forcePlay, 700),
   226	      window.setTimeout(forcePlay, 1400),
   227	      window.setTimeout(forcePlay, 2600),
   228	    ];
   229	
   230	    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
   231	      (entries) => {
   232	        if (entries.some((entry) => entry.isIntersecting)) forcePlay();
   233	      },
   234	      { threshold: 0.05 }
   235	    );
   236	
   237	    videos.forEach((video) => observer.observe(video));
   238	
   239	    window.addEventListener("touchstart", forcePlay, { passive: true });
   240	    window.addEventListener("pointerdown", forcePlay, { passive: true });
   241	    window.addEventListener("scroll", forcePlay, { passive: true });
   242	    window.addEventListener("resize", forcePlay);
   243	    window.addEventListener("orientationchange", forcePlay);
   244	    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", forcePlay);
   245	
   246	    return () => {
   247	      timers.forEach(window.clearTimeout);
   248	      observer.disconnect();
   249	
   250	      videos.forEach((video) => {
   251	        video.removeEventListener("loadedmetadata", forcePlay);
   252	        video.removeEventListener("loadeddata", forcePlay);
   253	        video.removeEventListener("canplay", forcePlay);
   254	        video.removeEventListener("canplaythrough", forcePlay);
   255	        video.removeEventListener("pause", forcePlay);
   256	      });
   257	
   258	      window.removeEventListener("touchstart", forcePlay);
   259	      window.removeEventListener("pointerdown", forcePlay);
   260	      window.removeEventListener("scroll", forcePlay);
   261	      window.removeEventListener("resize", forcePlay);
   262	      window.removeEventListener("orientationchange", forcePlay);
   263	      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", forcePlay);
   264	    };
   265	  }, []);
   266	
   267	
   268	  useEffect(() => {
   269	    const videos = [desktopVideoRef.current, mobileVideoRef.current].filter(Boolean) as HTMLVideoElement[];
   270	
   271	    const forcePlay = () => {
   272	      videos.forEach((video) => {
   273	        video.muted = true;
   274	        video.defaultMuted = true;
   275	        video.playsInline = true;
   276	        video.autoplay = true;
   277	        video.loop = true;
   278	        video.preload = "auto";
   279	        video.playbackRate = 0.72;
   280	
   281	        const attempt = video.play();
   282	        if (attempt && typeof attempt.catch === "function") {
   283	          attempt.catch(() => {
   284	            // Algunos navegadores bloquean hasta primer gesto del usuario.
   285	          });
   286	        }
   287	      });
   288	    };
   289	
   290	    forcePlay();
   291	
   292	    const timers = [
   293	      window.setTimeout(forcePlay, 250),
   294	      window.setTimeout(forcePlay, 900),
   295	      window.setTimeout(forcePlay, 1800),
   296	    ];
   297	
   298	    window.addEventListener("touchstart", forcePlay, { passive: true });
   299	    window.addEventListener("pointerdown", forcePlay, { passive: true });
   300	    window.addEventListener("scroll", forcePlay, { passive: true });
   301	    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", forcePlay);
   302	
   303	    return () => {
   304	      timers.forEach(window.clearTimeout);
   305	      window.removeEventListener("touchstart", forcePlay);
   306	      window.removeEventListener("pointerdown", forcePlay);
   307	      window.removeEventListener("scroll", forcePlay);
   308	      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", forcePlay);
   309	    };
   310	  }, []);
   311	
   312	  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<Locale>("es");
   313	  const [activeSlide, setActiveSlide] = useState(0);
   314	  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement | null>(null);
   315	
   316	  useEffect(() => {
   317	    const saved = window.localStorage.getItem(LOCALE_KEY) as Locale | null;
   318	    if (saved && saved in locales) setLocale(saved);
   319	
   320	    const onChange = (event: Event) => {
   321	      const next = (event as CustomEvent<Locale>).detail;
   322	      if (next && next in locales) setLocale(next);
   323	    };
   324	
   325	    window.addEventListener("across-locale-change", onChange);
   326	    return () => window.removeEventListener("across-locale-change", onChange);
   327	  }, []);
   328	
   329	  const t = copy[locale];
   330	  const slides = t.slides;
   331	  const slide = slides[activeSlide % slides.length];
   332	
   333	  useEffect(() => {
   334	    setActiveSlide(0);
   335	  }, [locale]);
   336	
   337	  useEffect(() => {
   338	    const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
   339	      setActiveSlide((current) => (current + 1) % slides.length);
   340	    }, 5200);
   341	
   342	    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
   343	  }, [slides.length]);
   344	
   345	  useEffect(() => {
   346	    const video = videoRef.current;
   347	    if (!video) return;
   348	
   349	    const forcePlay = () => {
   350	      video.muted = true;
   351	      video.defaultMuted = true;
   352	      video.playsInline = true;
   353	      video.setAttribute("muted", "");
   354	      video.setAttribute("playsinline", "");
   355	      video.setAttribute("webkit-playsinline", "");
   356	      video.load();
   357	      video.play().catch(() => {});
   358	    };
   359	
   360	    forcePlay();
   361	
   362	    window.addEventListener("touchstart", forcePlay, { once: true });
   363	    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", forcePlay);
   364	
   365	    return () => {
   366	      window.removeEventListener("touchstart", forcePlay);
   367	      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", forcePlay);
   368	    };
   369	  }, []);
   370	
   371	  return (
   372	    <section className={styles.hero}>
   373	      <video
   374	        ref={videoRef}
   375	        className={`${styles.video} ${styles.desktopVideo}`}
   376	        autoPlay
   377	        muted
   378	        loop
   379	        playsInline
   380	        preload="auto"
   381	        disablePictureInPicture
   382	        aria-hidden="true"
   383	      >
   384	        <source src="/videos/Across-Demo.mp4" type="video/mp4" />
   385	      </video>
   386	
   387	      <video
   388	        ref={videoRef}
   389	        className={`${styles.video} ${styles.mobileVideo}`}
   390	        autoPlay
   391	        muted
   392	        loop
   393	        playsInline
   394	        preload="auto"
   395	        disablePictureInPicture
   396	        aria-hidden="true"
   397	      >
   398	        <source src="/videos/Across-Demo-mobile.mp4" type="video/mp4" />
   399	      </video>
   400	
   401	      <div className={styles.overlay} />
   402	      <div className={styles.redGlow} />
   403	
   404	      <div className={styles.content}>
   405	        <div className={styles.titleWrap}>
   406	          <h1 className={styles.title}>
   407	            {slide.title.split("\n").map((line, index) => (
   408	              <span key={`${line}-${index}`}>{line}</span>
   409	            ))}
   410	          </h1>
   411	
   412	          <p className={styles.subtitle}>{slide.text}</p>
   413	        </div>
   414	
   415	        <div className={styles.line} />
   416	
   417	        <div className={styles.actions}>
   418	          <a href="/cotizacion" className={styles.primaryBtn}>
   419	            {t.cta}
   420	          </a>
   421	
   422	          <a href="/contacto" className={styles.secondaryBtn}>
   423	            {t.secondary}
   424	          </a>
   425	        </div>
   426	      </div>
   427	
   428	      <div className={styles.commandBar}>
   429	        {t.quickLinks.map((item) => {
   430	          const Icon = item.icon;
   431	
   432	          return (
   433	            <a href={item.href} key={item.title} className={styles.commandItem}>
   434	              <Icon />
   435	              <div>
   436	                <span>{item.title}</span>
   437	                <small>{item.subtitle}</small>
   438	              </div>
   439	            </a>

   442	      </div>

   444	  );
   445	}
